classes.name: Blend_AppFunction
classes.summary: Deferred class for a function used to compute a blending surface between two surfaces, using a guide line. The vector <X> used in Value, Values and Derivatives methods has to be the vector of the parametric coordinates U1,V1, U2,V2, of the extremities of a section on the first and second surface.

instanceMethods.name: NbVariables
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of variables of the function.

instanceMethods.name: NbEquations
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of equations of the function.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: computes the values <F> of the Functions for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Derivatives
instanceMethods.comment: returns the values <D> of the derivatives for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Values
instanceMethods.signature: (X: math_Vector, F: math_Vector, D: math_Matrix): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: returns the values <F> of the functions and the derivatives <D> for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the value of the parameter along the guide line. This determines the plane in which the solution has to be found.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the bounds of the parametric interval on the guide line. This determines the derivatives in these values if the function is not Cn.

instanceMethods.name: GetTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns in the vector Tolerance the parametric tolerance for each of the 4 variables; Tol is the tolerance used in 3d space.

instanceMethods.name: GetTolerance
instanceMethods.signature: (BoundTol: number, SurfTol: number, AngleTol: number, Tol3d: math_Vector, Tol1D: math_Vector): void
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the tolerance to reach in approximation to respect BoundTol error at the Boundary AngleTol tangent error at the Boundary SurfTol error inside the surface.

instanceMethods.name: GetBounds
instanceMethods.comment: Returns in the vector InfBound the lowest values allowed for each of the 4 variables. Returns in the vector SupBound the greatest values allowed for each of the 4 variables.

instanceMethods.name: IsSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if Sol is a zero of the function. Tol is the tolerance used in 3d space. The computation is made at the current value of the parameter on the guide line.

instanceMethods.name: GetMinimalDistance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the minimal Distance between two extremities of calculated sections.

instanceMethods.name: Pnt1
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the point on the first support.

instanceMethods.name: Pnt2
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the point on the first support.

instanceMethods.name: IsRational
instanceMethods.comment: Returns if the section is rational.

instanceMethods.name: GetSectionSize
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the length of the maximum section.

instanceMethods.name: GetMinimalWeight
instanceMethods.comment:
Compute the minimal value of weight for each poles of all sections.
@param Weigths Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: NbIntervals
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of intervals for continuity . May be one if Continuity(me) >= .

classes.name: Blend_SurfCurvFuncInv
classes.summary:
Deferred class for a function used to compute a blending surface between a surface and a curve, using a guide line. This function is used to find a solution on a done restriction of the surface.
The vector <X> used in Value, Values and Derivatives methods has to be the vector of the parametric coordinates wguide, wcurv, wrst where wguide is the parameter on the guide line, wcurv is the parameter on the curve, wrst is the parameter on the restriction on the surface.

instanceMethods.name: NbVariables
instanceMethods.comment: Returns 3.

instanceMethods.name: NbEquations
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of equations of the function.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: computes the values <F> of the Functions for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Derivatives
instanceMethods.comment: returns the values <D> of the derivatives for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Values
instanceMethods.signature: (X: math_Vector, F: math_Vector, D: math_Matrix): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: returns the values <F> of the functions and the derivatives <D> for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Set the Point on which a solution has to be found.

instanceMethods.name: GetTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns in the vector Tolerance the parametric tolerance for each of the 3 variables; Tol is the tolerance used in 3d space.

instanceMethods.name: GetBounds
instanceMethods.comment: Returns in the vector InfBound the lowest values allowed for each of the 3 variables. Returns in the vector SupBound the greatest values allowed for each of the 3 variables.

instanceMethods.name: IsSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if Sol is a zero of the function. Tol is the tolerance used in 3d space.

classes.summary: Deferred class for a function used to compute a blending surface between a surface and a pcurve on an other Surface, using a guide line. The vector <X> used in Value, Values and Derivatives methods may be the vector of the parametric coordinates U,V, W of the extremities of a section on the surface and the curve.

instanceMethods.name: NbVariables
instanceMethods.comment: Returns 3 (default value). Can be redefined.

instanceMethods.name: NbEquations
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of equations of the function.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: computes the values <F> of the Functions for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.comment: returns the values <F> of the functions and the derivatives <D> for the variable <X>. Returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the value of the parameter along the guide line. This determines the plane in which the solution has to be found.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the bounds of the parametric interval on the guide line. This determines the derivatives in these values if the function is not Cn.

instanceMethods.name: GetTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns in the vector Tolerance the parametric tolerance for each variable. Tol is the tolerance used in 3d space.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the tolerance to reach in approximation to respect BoundTol error at the Boundary AngleTol tangent error at the Boundary SurfTol error inside the surface.

instanceMethods.name: GetBounds
instanceMethods.comment: Returns in the vector InfBound the lowest values allowed for each variable. Returns in the vector SupBound the greatest values allowed for each of the 3 variables.

instanceMethods.name: IsSolution
